design: Each lane: independent RSI in the listed strata, 100 real prefix substeps, 1/3/5/10 x 20ms perturbed learned feedback then return to unperturbed feedback. Total jaw width additions Uniform[0,14] mm; arm vector random direction, norm Uniform[0,25] mrad, every fourth lane zero arm or zero jaw. Validity stops after first hard terminal. All attempts retained; no case references.
